q: Which real DJs are in GTA Online nightclubs?
a: The After Hours update in July 2018 added Solomun, Tale Of Us, Dixon and The Black Madonna, who now performs as The Blessed Madonna. The Cayo Perico Heist in December 2020 added The Music Locker with Moodymann, Keinemusik and Palms Trax.

q: Who plays at The Music Locker in GTA Online?
a: Moodymann, Keinemusik and Palms Trax are the residents of The Music Locker, the club beneath The Diamond Casino. Recorded sets by all three were posted to YouTube in early 2021.

q: Are the GTA Online Dr. Dre songs on Spotify?
a: Yes. The six Dr. Dre tracks premiered in GTA Online's The Contract on December 15, 2021 and reached streaming services in early February 2022, ahead of his Super Bowl halftime show.

q: How do I unlock the CircoLoco mix in GTA Online?
a: Find the four Monday Dreamin' EP media sticks (Black, Blue, Violet and Green) hidden around the map after Los Santos Tuners. Collecting all four unlocks Seth Troxler's CLR Launch Party mix in the Media Player.

q: Is Frank Ocean's blonded radio still in GTA?
a: blonded Los Santos 97.8 FM arrived with The Doomsday Heist on December 12, 2017. Per the GTA wiki it was added to GTA Online and GTA V's story mode at the same time.

q: What is CircoLoco Records and what does it have to do with GTA?
a: CircoLoco Records is a label announced on May 24, 2021 as a joint venture between CircoLoco and Rockstar Games. Its releases appear in GTA Online through the LS Car Meet, media sticks and a Radio Los Santos premiere.

q: Did being in GTA Online boost the DJs' streams?
a: No artist-level streaming numbers have been published. The Black Madonna said the game changed her fanbase within a month, and Rockstar's own estimate is 75 billion minutes of music listened to across GTA V and GTA Online.
